faq.q: Which pixel pitch is right for my auditorium?
faq.a: Pixel pitch depends on the distance from the front row to the screen. With the front row 3–5 m away, P2–P2.5 is usually the right fit; large halls over 8 m can use P3. SKV will survey your venue and recommend the most cost-effective configuration.

faq.q: How long does an auditorium screen installation take?
faq.a: For a 20–40 m² screen, installation typically takes 3–7 days from equipment delivery, including framing, electrical work, module mounting, calibration and handover.

faq.q: Who operates the screen after handover?
faq.a: SKV trains your staff on site, provides operating documentation and offers remote technical support throughout the warranty period.

faq.a: Yes. Fine-pitch LED has no tiling bezels, uniform brightness and more flexible sizing than an LCD video wall, making it ideal for meeting rooms of 20 m² and up.
